headline_stat.name: POST-sleep SWRs with significant sequential replay

justification.dataset: 000044 Achilles CA1 is the canonical Buzsáki dataset for hippocampal SWR and replay, an expert-standard choice.
justification.handling: Real LFP and spikes streamed from DANDI with correct µV conversion, Non-REM masking, epoch/state alignment, and explicit place-cell and run-bout criteria.
justification.analysis: Standard SWR detection plus Bayesian decoding with weighted time-position correlation, both cell-ID and circular time-shift shuffle nulls, and a PRE-sleep control at chance.
justification.correctness: Every headline number (72 significant = 46 fwd + 26 rev, 11.0% POST, 4.5% PRE, Mann-Whitney p~1e-9) reproduces from the code and figures and is internally consistent.
justification.figures: All four figures are clearly labeled with units and sample sizes and show the ripple waveform, place-field tiling, forward/reverse replay, and peri-SWR modulation.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate and the PRE control is reported honestly at chance, but no explicit limitations section is given, holding it at 3 for an otherwise clean result.
justification.verdict: Publication-quality, well-controlled replay demonstration that a supervisor would accept with at most minor requested caveats.
